name: klirr-desktop
description: Klirr desktop app (Tauri): the web UI on the native audio host

scripts.icons: tauri icon icon.svg && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const f of fs.readdirSync('src-tauri/icons')) if (/^(android|ios|Square.*|StoreLogo.*)$/.test(f)) fs.rmSync('src-tauri/icons/' + f, { recursive: true });"
